policy: PLAN picks an image by TAG; it does not hunt the web (the model's image-finding is the weak link). Preferred source is our OWN generated/curated library — on-brand and self-contained. At BRAND, owned images embed (SVG inline, raster compressed) and ALWAYS win over the Unsplash fallback. Unsplash is a CDN stopgap for tags the owned library does not cover yet. Every entry carries provenance for the Sources manifest + client license gate.

owned.note: Owned brand assets live in assets/images/ (alongside logos + fonts) and are referenced skill-root-relative in `file`. SVG assets embed inline as tiny self-contained data URIs; raster (.jpg/.png) drop-ins (e.g. ChatGPT-generated photos) embed compressed via Pillow. Set status='seeded' once a real file is present and approved_for_client=true. These embed at BRAND and take priority over unsplash_fallback. CLIENT/PARTNER LOGOS: when a deck cites another company, use its official logo via the `client-<slug>` tag (files in assets/images/clients/, sourced from our own site — never web-scraped).
